_comment: GhostGuard Cloud scoped-key + webhook config (M3.2). Point GHOSTGUARD_CLOUD_CONFIG_FILE at a filled-in copy of this file. Every key below is a PLACEHOLDER — replace with long random values, and never commit the real file. Scopes: ingest (POST /v1/records), read (GET records/report/inbox/decision/export), decide (POST a decision), admin (DELETE /v1/workspace). Omitting scopes gives a key all four. Multiple keys per workspace may be live at once — that overlap is how rotation works: add the new key, roll agents onto it, then remove the old key and restart to revoke it.

webhook._comment: Optional. On every decision in this workspace, the server POSTs the decision JSON to this URL with header x-ghostguard-signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 hex of the exact body, keyed by secret>.
